QUOTE: A declared `index_scope` is used only if it is usable. ... A rejected declaration is refused at the CLI with exit 1 ... It is not silently widened. ... When nothing is declared ... The fallback is `whole_repo_scope`

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer says a usable declared scope is used and that nothing declared falls back to the whole repo. But it says a rejected declaration is refused rather than widened, which contradicts "every failure falls through to whole-repo."
